prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create an exquisite fine-art paper collage in exact landscape 1672x941. Aged ivory paper, muted indigo printed photographic textures, restrained amber light, handmade ragged edges, shallow physical paper shadows. An expansive calm sea at dawn inside one horizontal torn old photograph, faded blue mountains on the horizon, an understated small gold sun toward upper-right, a single pressed ivory flower tucked at far left. The central ivory paper above the sea is spacious for editable title, bottom ivory paper clear. Quiet release, warmth and silence. No words, letters, text, logos, people or watermarks. Bottom 18 percent quiet ivory for editable Chinese lyrics. Gallery quality and rich tactile detail, no digital glossy effects.
